lines.en: Misha, where is my book?
Your book? It is not here.
And who is here?
Only me, Anya.
Only you? And no book.

lines.ru: Книга у Ивана. Он тут живёт.
lines.en: Ivan has the book. He lives here.
Ivan? He lives here?
He does. For a year now.
And the book? What is it about?
About the country. About our country.
I would like that book.

lines.ru: Книга у Ивана. Иди к нему.
lines.en: Ivan has it. Go to him.
Anya, I have the book.
Ivan! You have the book?
I do. But it is yours.

questions.ask: What is Anya looking for?
Who has it?
Who else is in the room?
What is the book about?
How does she get the book back?

lines.en: Katya, what is happening today?
Today? A big day.
Big? What sort of day?
The sort where you say everything.
Say it? To whom?
To everyone. But not here.
Not here? Where, then?
There, where everyone is.
Do you have to say it?
I have to. Today.
And what will you say?

lines.ru: Что я не могу так жить.
lines.en: That I cannot go on living like this.
But that is a very big day.
Yes, Boris. But I have to.

questions.ask: What kind of day is it for Katya?
What is she going to do?
Where will she do it?
What is she going to tell them?
options: That she cannot live like this

questions.ask: How does Boris respond?
options: He says it is a big day
He talks her out of it

lines.en: Lena, are you thinking about something?
I am. Watching and thinking.
What are you looking at?
At them. They are my friends.
Friends? All of them?
All of them. And not for the first time.
Not the first time? How so?

lines.ru: Так. При них я могу всё.
lines.en: Like this. With them I can do anything.
With them? And with me?
With you too, Oleg.
So I will become a friend as well?
You will. Already.
Already? I do not think so.
Well, think about it, Oleg.

questions.ask: What is Lena doing?
Who are the people she is watching?
What does she say she can do with them?
What does she tell Oleg?
options: He is becoming a friend too
He is not one of them

questions.ask: Does Oleg believe her?

core3:3.title: Her first hour in the city

lines.en: Nina, can you see the city?
I can. For the first time.
The first time? In your whole life?

lines.ru: За всю жизнь. Я тут час.
lines.en: In my whole life. I have been here an hour.
An hour? And what do you see?
I see everything. And everyone.
And afterwards? What then?
Afterwards — I do not know.
You do not know? No words at all?
No words. This is a city.
Such a city, such a life.
Yes, Yura. I can see that.
Another hour? Or is that enough?
Another hour. The first hour.

questions.ask: Is Nina from this city?
options: No, it is her first time

questions.ask: How long has she been there?
What does she say about what comes next?
How does she describe the city?
options: She has no words for it
She says it is too big
She says it is like home

questions.ask: What does she want at the end?

lines.en: Sonya, when will you be here?
When? Today.
Today? What about now?
Viktor, I have a lot of work.
A lot of work? How much?
A great deal. All day.
All day! And when are you free?
When am I free? After work.
After work — when is that?
That is an hour. One hour.
An hour is not much.
Not much. But it is mine.
So when will you be here, Sonya?
Today. After work.

questions.ask: Why can Sonya not come now?
options: She has a lot of work

questions.ask: How long does her work last?
How much free time does she have?
What does she say about that hour?
When will she come?

lines.en: Masha, where is the key?
The key? In the kitchen.
In the kitchen? Whereabouts?
It is lying by the wall.

lines.ru: Нет его тут. Кто сидит на кухне?
lines.en: It is not here. Who is sitting in the kitchen?
Ivan is there. He is sitting.
Ivan? On which floor?
On our floor. The first.
The first floor? And the stairs?
The stairs are here, Pyotr. Go on.
I am going. Does Ivan have the key?
He may have. He is sitting there.

lines.ru: Ключ у меня. Он был на кухне.
lines.en: I have the key. It was in the kitchen.
Ivan! You have the key?
I do. I am sitting right here.

questions.ask: What is Pyotr looking for?
Where does Masha say it is?
options: In the kitchen by the wall

questions.ask: Does he find it there?
Who is sitting in the kitchen?
Who has the key?

lines.en: Nina, where is my chair?
The chair? It is in the yard.
In the yard? Why there?
All the chairs are out there now.
And the armchair? And the bed?
The armchair is here. The bed too.
And the mirror? Is it on the wall?
On the wall. A very big one.
And the floor? What is on the floor?
Only the armchair is on the floor.
The armchair on the floor? How is that?
That is how it is, Tanya. It is a day at home.

lines.ru: Домашний день! И стул во дворе.
lines.en: A day at home! And my chair in the yard.

lines.ru: Стул во дворе. Кресло на полу.
lines.en: The chair in the yard. The armchair on the floor.

questions.ask: Where is Tanya's chair?
What is still in the room?
Where is the mirror?
How does Nina explain it?
options: She calls it a day at home
She says it was an accident

questions.ask: How does Tanya sound about her chair?

home:2.title: The house is being done up

lines.en: Boris, what is going on here? Building work?
Building work, Katya. For a year now.
A year? And where is the furniture?
The furniture is in the yard. By the fence.
By the fence? And the glass?
The glass is here. It is clean.
Clean glass — and the floor?
The floor is not very clean.
And the cupboard? Where is that?
The cupboard is in the yard as well.
All the furniture is in the yard!
All of it. But it will be clean here.
Will be? When?
After the work. I think.

questions.ask: What is happening at Boris's house?
How long has it been going on?
Where is the furniture?
options: In the yard by the fence

questions.ask: What is not clean?
How sure is Boris that it will be finished?

lines.en: Anya, are you getting dressed yet?
I am. For an hour now.
An hour? What clothes!
The clothes are beautiful. Can you see?
I can. Very beautiful.
And what should I put on?
Put on what you usually wear.
I do not wear that.
You do not? What do you wear, then?
I only wear my own things.
Your own? And whose is that?

lines.ru: Это тоже моё. Но я сниму.
lines.en: That is mine too. But I will take it off.
Take it off? We are leaving!
Coming, Yura. I look fine already.

questions.ask: How long has Anya been getting ready?
What does Yura suggest?
What does she say about her clothes?
Why is Yura pressing her?
How does it end?

clothes:1.title: The tie in the coat pocket

lines.en: Lena, where is my tie?
Your tie? In the pocket, Viktor.
In the pocket? Which pocket?
In the coat pocket.
In the coat! And the suit?
The suit is here. It is a good one.

lines.ru: А куртка? Я её не ношу.
lines.en: And the jacket? I do not wear it.
You do not? And your shoes?
Shoes? They are already on.
Already? And my dress?
The dress? It is very beautiful.
Beautiful, but not mine.
Not yours? Whose is it, Lena?
That dress is Anya's. Mine is here.

questions.ask: What is Viktor looking for?
Where is it?
What does Viktor say about the jacket?
Is he ready to go?
Whose is the beautiful dress?

lines.en: Oleg, is that your jacket?
It is. And the shirt is mine.
A good shirt. And the ring?
The ring? That is not mine.
Not yours? Whose ring is it?
I do not know, Boris. It was just here.
And your T-shirt? Where is that?
The T-shirt? I do not wear it.
You do not? Is that fashion?

lines.ru: Мода? Я не о моде думаю.
lines.en: Fashion? I do not think about fashion.
And the beard? Is that fashion too?

lines.ru: Борода — это не мода. Это я.
lines.en: The beard is not fashion. It is me.
That is you all over! A jacket and a beard.
A jacket, a shirt and a beard.

questions.ask: What is Oleg wearing?
Whose is the ring?
Why has he no T-shirt on?
What does he say about fashion?
options: He does not think about it

questions.ask: What does he say the beard is?
